title: KB Creation Framework — Test Set
description: Schema for audit/test-set.yaml (v3.1.15+). Operator-curated ground-truth questions the KB MUST answer correctly. Inspect-runner scores at Phase 7.0; result feeds the 'Test-set passage rate' Quality Scorecard dimension. A KB cannot reach PASS verdict unless passage rate meets threshold (default 80%, configurable).

kb_root.description: Optional; auto-filled by runner if absent.

passage_rate.description: Minimum fraction of questions that must PASS to clear the dimension threshold.

per_question_severity.description: If 'blocker', any single FAIL blocks composite PASS. Otherwise treated as score input only.

solver.description: Optional. Only used in LLM mode. Defines how the LLM produces answers from the KB before scoring.

family.description: Per Rule 19, MUST differ from Builder A + Builder B + Phase 6.4 fact-checker families.

rubric.description: For model_graded — what counts as a correct answer (used to prompt the grader LLM).

topic_hint.description: Optional topic id to narrow search (otherwise scans all of full/).
